aso_context.primary_intent: Compare package size and unit value while grocery shopping
aso_context.secondary_intent: Keep a searchable private history of product checks
aso_context.experiment_hypothesis: A subtitle centered on package size and value will improve qualified product-page conversion without changing the verified feature promise.

locales.name: Shrinkflation Price Scanner
locales.subtitle: Track package size and value
locales.promotional_text: Scan a barcode, record today's package amount and shelf price, and compare it with your saved history-right in the aisle, with no account required.
locales.description:
Know what your dollar buys before you decide.

Shrinkflation Price Scanner helps you compare package amount and unit cost over time. Scan a barcode or enter a product manually, record today's package amount and shelf price, then save what you decided.

Your first check creates a baseline. On a later trip, the app compares the same product family and can show less product, a higher unit cost, better value, or no meaningful change.

CHECK THE EVIDENCE

- Look up supported barcodes in a built-in catalogue of 426,044 selected US branded-food products from USDA FoodData Central.
- Record in-store or online prices as regular, sale, or member prices.
- Link an unknown or changed barcode to a product you have already saved.
- Search and filter your on-device history.
- Edit decisions, delete checks, and undo a deletion for eight seconds.
- See estimated extra cost paid or avoided based on your recorded decision and quantity.

BUILT FOR THE US AND PUERTO RICO

Money is shown in dollars. The app supports English and Spanish tailored for Puerto Rico, with supermarket choices ordered for the detected US or Puerto Rico region.

PRIVACY AND ACCESS

No account is required. The catalogue and comparison tools use data bundled with the app. Saved price checks are stored locally on the device. Camera permission is used only when you choose to scan a barcode or shelf-price label.

The app includes a fixed banner. An optional one-time in-app purchase removes that banner. The localized purchase price appears in the app.

locales.name: Escáner de reduflación
locales.subtitle: Compara empaque y valor
locales.promotional_text: Escanea el código, registra la cantidad actual del empaque y el precio en la etiqueta, y compáralos con tu historial guardado, sin crear una cuenta.
locales.description:
Ten claro qué recibes por tu dinero antes de decidir.

Shrinkflation Price Scanner te ayuda a comparar la cantidad del empaque y el costo por unidad con el paso del tiempo. Escanea un código de barras o ingresa un producto manualmente, registra la cantidad actual y el precio en la etiqueta, y guarda lo que decidiste.

La primera revisión crea la base de comparación. En una compra posterior, la app compara la misma familia de productos y puede mostrar si el empaque trae menos, si subió el costo por unidad, si encontraste mejor valor o si no hubo un cambio importante.

REVISA LA EVIDENCIA

- Consulta códigos compatibles en un catálogo integrado de 426,044 alimentos de marca seleccionados para Estados Unidos de USDA FoodData Central.
- Registra precios en tienda o en línea, ya sean regulares, de oferta o para miembros.
- Vincula un código desconocido o nuevo con un producto que ya guardaste.
- Busca y filtra tu historial guardado en el dispositivo.
- Edita tus decisiones, elimina comparaciones y deshaz una eliminación durante ocho segundos.
- Consulta el costo adicional pagado o evitado que la app estima según tu decisión y la cantidad.

CREADA PARA ESTADOS UNIDOS Y PUERTO RICO

Los montos aparecen en dólares. La app está en inglés y en español adaptado para Puerto Rico, y ordena los supermercados según la región detectada.

PRIVACIDAD Y ACCESO

No necesitas crear una cuenta. El catálogo y las comparaciones usan datos incluidos en la app. Tus comparaciones se guardan localmente en el dispositivo. La app solicita acceso a la cámara solo cuando decides escanear un código o una etiqueta de precio.

La app incluye un banner fijo. Una compra opcional de un solo pago dentro de la app elimina ese banner. El precio localizado aparece en la app.

review.notes:
# App Review notes

No account or credentials are required. Camera access is optional; choose manual entry to test without a camera. No external hardware is required.

Start a shopping trip by choosing a supermarket. Scan a supported barcode or enter a product manually, then enter the current package amount and shelf price. A first saved check creates the baseline. Save a later check in the same product family to see a comparison.

The 426,044-product USDA catalogue, saved history, and comparison logic work without an internet connection. Internet is required for StoreKit product metadata and purchases, Google advertising, and the external policy and support pages.

To test an unknown barcode, enter a valid code that is not in the bundled catalogue and link it to any existing saved product family. History supports search, filters, edited decisions, deletion, and an eight-second undo. The Impact tab excludes zero-value chart points.

Banner removal is in Settings under Banner. Remove Banner is a non-consumable purchase with product ID `com.worksbienstudios.shrinkflationpricescanner.removeads`. Restore Purchase is in the same section. Core scanning, comparison, history, and impact features do not require the purchase.

The prepared TestFlight configuration uses Google's official sample ad identifiers. Sample-ad mode intentionally bypasses UMP and should show only sample ads. Invalid, unavailable, or offline ad states show no replacement banner. A production App Store build must use verified production advertising identifiers and matching UMP, ATT, privacy-manifest, and App Privacy configuration.

Availability is limited to the United States and Puerto Rico. The app interface supports English and Puerto Rico-aware Spanish. App Store Connect's Spanish Mexico locale is used only as the available Spanish metadata container.
